name: Caro-Kann Defense
description: A rock-solid and resilient defense for Black against 1.e4, renowned for its strong pawn structure and endgame potential.

variations.name: Classical Variation
variations.moves: 1. e4 c6 2. d4 d5 3. Nc3 dxe4 4. Nxe4 Bf5

explanations.c6: Black prepares d5 with the Caro-Kann Defense.
explanations.d4: White builds a strong central presence.
explanations.Bf5: Black develops the light-squared bishop outside the pawn chain (Classical main line).

explanations.e5: White pushes space in the Advance Variation.
explanations.Bf5: Black successfully escapes with the light-squared bishop before playing e6.
explanations.c5: Black strikes at White's d4-pawn base.

variations.name: Exchange Variation
variations.moves: 1. e4 c6 2. d4 d5 3. exd5 cxd5 4. Bd3 Nc6 5. c3 Nf6

explanations.exd5: White exchanges pawns to open lines.
explanations.cxd5: Black recaptures, creating a symmetrical pawn structure.
explanations.Nf6: Black develops the knight toward the center.

variations.name: Panov Attack
variations.moves: 1. e4 c6 2. d4 d5 3. exd5 cxd5 4. c4 Nf6 5. Nc3 e6

explanations.c4: White transitions into the Panov Attack, playing for an isolated queen's pawn position.

variations.name: Two Knights Variation
variations.moves: 1. e4 c6 2. Nc3 d5 3. Nf3 Bg4 4. h3 Bxf3 5. Qxf3 e6

explanations.Bxf3: Black trades bishop for knight to damage pawn structure.

variations.name: Fantasy Variation
variations.moves: 1. e4 c6 2. d4 d5 3. f3 dxe4 4. fxe4 e5 5. Nf3 exd4

explanations.f3: White plays the aggressive Fantasy Variation.
explanations.e5: Black strikes back in the center.

variations.name: Tartakower Variation
variations.moves: 1. e4 c6 2. d4 d5 3. Nc3 dxe4 4. Nxe4 Nf6 5. Nxf6+ exf6

explanations.exf6: Black recaptures with the e-pawn for an endgame-oriented structure.

variations.name: Bronstein-Larsen Variation
variations.moves: 1. e4 c6 2. d4 d5 3. Nc3 dxe4 4. Nxe4 Nf6 5. Nxf6+ gxf6

explanations.gxf6: Black recaptures with the g-pawn, keeping open lines for counterplay on the g-file.

variations.name: Karpov Variation
variations.moves: 1. e4 c6 2. d4 d5 3. Nc3 dxe4 4. Nxe4 Nd7

explanations.Nd7: Black plays the flexible Karpov variation, preparing to safely trade minor pieces.

variations.name: Smyslov Variation
variations.moves: 1. e4 c6 2. d4 d5 3. Nc3 dxe4 4. Nxe4 Nd7 5. Bc4 Ngf6 6. Ng5 e6

explanations.e6: Black solidly covers the f7 weakness.
